title: Cummins Engine Company — Annual Report 1989
status: built — worked example of the live-data path
page_set: financial highlights (live KPIs + live trend table)
palette_provenance: stock = modal colour of the cover scan; the four accents are the mean of the darkest third of each hue cluster of Rand's exploded-engine drawing; interior stock is deliberately near-white because a bound table's row fill is always white and cannot be themed
best_for: data-heavy reports wanting a restrained modernist frame and a ready-made 4-colour categorical palette
features: build-time warehouse figures typeset as a ledger
render-time bound tables and KPIs in the same document
per-row currency marks in a wide matrix
cropped cover artwork matched to the page stock
top-N live table with the tail accounted for in a footnote
live KPI band that still matches the page
live bound tables framed as typeset 'data plates'
deviations: cover artwork is Rand's drawing, reused as the template's signature
interior layout is inferred: only the cover was available to measure
data pages use a near-white sheet rather than the cover's grey: a bound table's cell/header fill is always white and cannot be tinted, so the stock is chosen to meet it

data_paths.render_time: highlights KPIs, five-year trend, product family and store region tables — all bound, re-query on every export
data_paths.build_time: statement of trading results and five-year summary — resolved by warehouse.query() then typeset, which is what allows dot leaders and ruled totals
